test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

The task has been _______ to the juniors.
solution: The correct answer is '**assigned**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence states that the task was given to the juniors. • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**assigned**'. • It means **'to give somebody a particular job to do'.** (किसी को नियुक्त करना, कार्यभार सौंपना) • *Example: The case has been **assigned** to our most senior officer.* **Correct Sentence:__** *The task has been **assigned** to the juniors.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of the other words: • **Attached**: liking somebody/something very much. (अनुरक्त, लगाव-युक्त) • **Hired**: to have the use of something for a short time by paying for it. (किसी वस्‍तु को किराए पर लेना) • **Elected**: to choose somebody to have a particular job or position by voting for him/her. [मतदान के द्वारा (किसी को) निर्वाचित करना या चुनना] 37:T661, The correct answer is **'blew out'.**
